items.headline: O API: GPT-4 series deprecation scheduled
items.summary: O notified developers that certain GPT-4 series models will be deprecated/removed from the API on 2027-01-14. Short-term impact for integrators; may pressure migration plans and near-term demand for replacements.

items.headline: O: ChatGPT release notes include new October updates
items.summary: ChatGPT release notes list October 9, 2026 changes. Treat as incremental product evolution; without detailed revenue/capacity commitments, it mainly signals ongoing iteration rather than a step-change.
